configs.question: • We use the present perfect for:
configs.correctAnswer: a things that started in the past and are still true now.

additionalAnswers.answer: a things that started in the past and are still true now.
b things that are starting now and continue in the future.

Figure it out

A: Do you like this band?

B: Yes, I love them! I’ve listened to all of their songs, but I haven’t been to any of their concerts. The tickets are really expensive.

Choose the correct option (a or b) to complete rules 1 and 2 in the grammar box.

Grammar | Present perfect affirmative and negative

She’s lost her phone!

﻿

I’ve travelled to lots of different countries.


• We form the affirmative with have / has + past participle.

• We form the negative with haven’t / hasn’t + past participle.
